names: ST LUKES HOSPITAL AT THE VINTAGE
UNIVERSITY OF TEXAS M.D. ANDERSON CANCER CENTER
datasets_used: HIFLD Next hospitals-3 (geopackage, 8,340 US hospital points; filtered to COUNTYFIPS 48201 and STATE TX, 110 Harris County hospitals)
FEMA NFHL Harris County extract /root/.cache/hifld-qgis-agent-errors/nfhl/48201C/S_FLD_HAZ_AR.shp (10,806 flood hazard polygons; SFHA defined as SFHA_TF = 'T', 4,370 polygons)
output.method: I downloaded the HIFLD hospitals geopackage, kept the 110 points with Harris County FIPS 48201 in Texas, and filtered the NFHL S_FLD_HAZ_AR polygons to SFHA_TF = 'T' (the 1%-annual-chance floodplain). A point-in-polygon selection (intersect) in QGIS returned 11 hospitals inside the SFHA; 8 of these are listed as OPEN and 3 as CLOSED, so the count of 11 is all hospital records in the dataset, and 8 if only open facilities are counted.
